preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of operations m must be between 1 and 200,000.
The length of the input string s must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= len(s) for l, r, c in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation must have valid indices l and r within the current length of the string.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(s[i] for i in range(len(s)) if i not in removed_indices)
postconditions.description: The output string must consist of characters from the original string that were not removed by any operation.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len(s) - sum(len(removed_indices) for removed_indices in removed_indices_list)
postconditions.description: The length of the output string must equal the original length minus the total number of characters removed.
